title: When the Inventory Breaks
author: Wren Galloway
blurb: Ivo Brightwater, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
